title: The Abandoned Mill
text: A mill on a fast black river, its wheel still turning, its stones still grinding nothing. Nobody is home. Flour lies thick on every surface, unmarked by feet. The grain in the loft is dry and sweet, as if it was stored last week.

options.label: Strip it for timber and iron.

outcomes.text: The timber and iron come away easily. All the while the wheel keeps turning, grinding nothing, faster whenever your backs are turned.

options.label: Search the mill for the miller.

outcomes.text: The miller is hiding in the cellar, white with flour and terror. He pays you gladly, if only to see you gone.
You find the miller in the wheel, still going round with every turn.

options.label: Rest here a night, and listen to the wheel.

outcomes.text: The wheel turns all night, steady as a heartbeat. For once, nobody dreams.
